ENCLAVE · LOCAL WALLET HANDOFF · SITE ACTIVATION

Publish the Enclave site and deploy one staging instance

Five MetaMask confirmations from the administrator account, in this order: (1) sign the upload authorization for the frozen site package, (2) publish catalog version enclave-site:1, (3) create the public site deployment on the Hyper-V host tier, then on the reviewed lease-gas page (4) deposit 0.001 ETH lease gas and (5) enable its sponsorship policy. No USDC and no other funds. Network fees are extra.
